topic: Using the Mahjong Mirror's four angles to prepare for the Fire Sheep year 2027: naming what you're building, knowing yourself in transitions, surfacing what opposes a clean arrival, and building emotional steadiness while the Horse year's energy is still available.
phrases: Build it now. Carry it forward.
The path is built on this side of the door.
The calm year rewards what the loud one built.

images.concept: A woman writing carefully in a journal, seen from an angle, her attention completely focused on the page. The act of naming, planning, preparing. Warm light, a deliberate quiet moment amid a season of action.
images.prompt: A cinematic wide shot: a woman seated at a table, leaning forward over an open journal, writing carefully. Seen from the side or behind. The pen is moving; she is in the act of thinking on paper. The table holds only the journal, a cup of tea, and a small candle. The room behind her is warm, quiet. Afternoon light falls across the page. The mood is intentional, deliberate, building something with thought rather than speed. Palette: warm ivory page, antique gold candlelight, deep walnut table surface, midnight jade background. Women never face camera directly. No text legible. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A half-built stone garden wall, hands visible in the act of placing the next stone. Building foundations before the season changes. The act of preparation made literal and beautiful.
images.prompt: A close wide shot of a garden stone wall being built. Hands (feminine, unhurried) are placing a stone into the structure. The wall is half-complete. The stones below are set solidly; the upper section is in progress. Green garden plants grow around the base of the wall. Afternoon light. The mood is craft, patience, building something that will last. Palette: warm grey stone, soft sage green plants, antique gold afternoon light, dark rich earth. No faces. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A woman from behind, standing at a workbench, arranging something she has made with her hands. Warm workshop light. The care and intention visible in her posture.
images.prompt: Square composition: a woman at a wooden workbench, seen from behind and slightly to the side. She is arranging objects on the bench with care. Her posture shows focus and intention. Workshop light warms the scene from above and to the left. The bench surface holds her work: something small, handmade, considered. The background is a warm, dim workshop or studio. Palette: antique gold overhead light, deep walnut wood surfaces, midnight jade shadow. Women never face camera directly. No text in image. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Two people walking a garden path together, side by side, seen from behind. The relationship tended and carried forward. The partnership that survives a transition because it was built with care.
images.prompt: A wide cinematic shot: two people walking side by side along a garden path, seen from behind. Their stride is easy, unhurried, in step with each other. Green flowering plants border the path. Evening light warms the scene. The mood is companionship, the ease of a relationship that has been genuinely tended. No faces visible. Palette: soft sage green borders, antique gold evening light, warm stone path. Women never face camera directly. No text in image. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A woman at a window seat with a journal and a cup of tea, pen in hand, making a real decision on paper. The intentional planning moment before a season changes.
images.prompt: Square composition: a woman sits at a window seat, seen in three-quarter profile from behind. On the surface beside her are an open journal, a cup of tea, and a small candle. She holds a pen and is in the act of writing or deciding. Light comes through the window, falling across the journal page. The garden outside is soft-focus. The mood is clarity, deliberate intention, preparing before the moment arrives. Palette: warm ivory page, antique gold light through window, soft sage garden visible beyond glass. Women never face camera directly. No text legible. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.
